# PhotoReactionProps

`jaff.core.PhotoReactionProps`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Photo-reaction state, held as `Reaction.photo` (`None` otherwise).

## Constructor

`#!python PhotoReactionProps(xsec=None, pi_database=None, override_custom_rate=None, override_custom_cross_section=None, custom_rad_rate=False, rgrouped=None, shielding=None)`



## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xsec` | `XsecProps or None` | Cross sections of the reaction's single decay channel, or `None` when no database has an entry. `xsec.total` holds the cross section averaged over the whole radiation spectrum (cm²). |
| `pi_database` | `str or None` | Per-reaction photoionization database override (`"norad"`, `"verner"` or `"leiden"`); `None` uses the global `pi_database`. |
| `override_custom_rate` | `bool or None` | Per-reaction override of `override_custom_rate`; `None` uses the global flag. |
| `override_custom_cross_section` | `bool or None` | Per-reaction override of `override_custom_cross_section`; `None` uses the global flag (`False` without radiation). |
| `custom_rad_rate` | `bool` | `True` when the rate comes from a `.jfunc` aux function rather than from the cross sections. |
| `rgrouped` | `list[GroupedPhotoReactionProps] or None` | One entry per radiation band, in `net.radiation.groups` order, set when a radiation field is configured; `None` otherwise. See `band_xsecs`. |
| `shielding` | `ShieldingProps or None` | Shielding applied to the photo rate, or `None` when the reaction is not shielded. |
